mapper.select: SELECT br.bp_relation_type, br.description FROM hls_bp_relation br, hls_bp_master bm WHERE bm.bp_class = br.bp_class AND bm.bp_id = #{bpId ,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT bm.bp_code, bm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master bm WHERE bm.bp_id != #{bpId ,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND bm.bp_class = ( SELECT bm_b.bp_class FROM hls_bp_master bm_b WHERE bm_b.bp_id = #{bpId ,jdbcType=BIGINT} )

SELECT hmr.bp_id, hmr.relation_bp_id, hbr.bp_relation_type, hbr.description, hbm.bp_code, hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master_relation hmr, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_bp_relation hbr WHERE hmr.relation_bp_id = hbm.bp_id AND hmr.bp_relation_type = hbr.bp_relation_type AND hmr.bp_id = #{bpId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT hmr.bp_id, hmr.relation_bp_id, hbr.bp_relation_type, hbr.description, hbm.bp_code, hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master_relation hmr, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_bp_relation hbr WHERE hmr.relation_bp_id = hbm.bp_id AND hmr.bp_relation_type = hbr.bp_relation_type AND hbr.bp_class = #{personType}

SELECT hmr.bp_relation_id, hmr.bp_id, hmr.relation_bp_id, hmr.bp_relation_type, (select sc.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v sc where sc.code = 'BP.CUSTOMER_RELATIONSHIP' AND sc.CODE_VALUE = hmr.bp_relation_type) bp_relation_type_n, hbm.bp_code, hbm.bp_code bp_code_n, hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master_relation hmr left join hls_bp_master hbm on hmr.relation_bp_id = hbm.bp_id WHERE hmr.bp_id = #{bpId}

select hbmr.*,hbm.bp_name relatedBpIdN,hbr.description relationTypeN, (select v.meaning value_name from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'BP_RELATION_STATUS' and v.code_value = hbmr.admit_status)admitStatusN from hls_bp_master_relation hbmr left join hls_bp_master hbm on hbm.bp_id = hbmr.related_bp_id left join hls_bp_relation hbr on hbmr.relation_type = hbr.bp_relation_type where hbmr.bp_id = #{bpId} order by hbmr.enabled_flag desc,hbmr.creation_date desc

select hbmr.*,hbm.bp_name relatedBpIdN,hbr.description relationTypeN, (select v.meaning value_name from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'BP_RELATION_STATUS' and v.code_value = hbmr.admit_status)admitStatusN, (select bm.bp_name from hls_bp_master bm where bm.bp_id = hbmr.bp_id) bpIdN from hls_bp_master_relation hbmr left join hls_bp_master hbm on hbm.bp_id = hbmr.related_bp_id left join hls_bp_relation hbr on hbmr.relation_type = hbr.bp_relation_type where hbmr.bp_relation_id = #{bpRelationId}

select hbmr.*,hbm.bp_name relatedBpIdN,hbr.description relationTypeN, (select v.meaning value_name from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'BP_RELATION_STATUS' and v.code_value = hbmr.admit_status)admitStatusN from hls_bp_master_relation hbmr left join hls_bp_master hbm on hbm.bp_id = hbmr.related_bp_id left join hls_bp_relation hbr on hbmr.relation_type = hbr.bp_relation_type where hbmr.bp_id = #{bpId}
